lead: Ravi Shastri is best known as an Indian cricketer, born on 27 May 1962 in Mumbai.
As of 2026, he is 64 years old, and his birth date places him under the Gemini sign.
He has represented India national cricket team and Mumbai cricket team and has been recognised with the Arjuna Award.
